info.title: Synapse Public API
info.description:
The Synapse public API, for partners and a venue's own developers.

**Auth.** `Authorization: Bearer syn_live_…` — an API key created in Settings → API keys.
Each key carries scopes; a call without the scope it needs is 403 `insufficient_scope`.

**Errors** are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`. Branch on `code`, never on `detail`.

**Lists** are cursor-paginated: `limit` (≤200) and `cursor`, answered with
`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`. Syncable lists take `updated_since`.

**Idempotency.** Creates and money-moving calls take an `Idempotency-Key` header; a retry
with the same key and body returns the original response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`.

**Rate limits.** 50-request burst, 1,000 an hour per key. See the `RateLimit-*` headers;
a 429 carries `Retry-After`.

**Money** is `{ minor, currency }`. Instants are RFC 3339 UTC.

get.description: Returns the key that made the call: its ID, organisation, scopes, the venues it is limited to (empty means all) and whether it is a live or test key. Any valid key can call it, whatever its scopes, so use it to check a key works.

bad_request.title: Bad request
bad_request.explanation: The request could not be read: malformed JSON, a body on a call that takes none, or a similar problem with its shape.
bad_request.fix: Check the request against the reference for this endpoint. The detail field says what was wrong.

validation_failed.title: Validation failed
validation_failed.explanation: The request was readable but did not match the endpoint's schema. The response carries an errors array, one entry per problem, each with a JSON-pointer-style path and a message.
validation_failed.fix: Fix each field named in errors[].path and send the request again.

invalid_cursor.title: Invalid cursor
invalid_cursor.explanation: The cursor parameter is not one this API issued, or it was changed.
invalid_cursor.fix: Pass next_cursor back exactly as the previous page returned it. To start from the beginning, leave cursor out.

idempotency_key_required.title: Idempotency-Key required
idempotency_key_required.explanation: This endpoint creates something or moves money, so it only runs with an Idempotency-Key header.
idempotency_key_required.fix: Send a unique Idempotency-Key header (a UUID is ideal) and reuse it only when retrying the same request.

invalid_idempotency_key.title: Invalid Idempotency-Key
invalid_idempotency_key.explanation: The Idempotency-Key header is longer than 255 characters.
invalid_idempotency_key.fix: Use a shorter key. A UUID is 36 characters.

unauthorized.title: Unauthorized
unauthorized.fix: Send your API key as Authorization: Bearer followed by the key.

invalid_api_key.title: Invalid API key
invalid_api_key.explanation: The Authorization header is missing, is not a Synapse key, or names a key that is unknown, revoked or expired, or belongs to an archived organisation. All of these return the same response on purpose.
invalid_api_key.fix: Check the key in Settings → API keys. If it was revoked or has expired, create a new one.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.explanation: The key is valid but this request is not allowed.
forbidden.fix: Check the detail field. If it is unclear, contact support with the instance value from the response.

insufficient_scope.title: Insufficient scope
insufficient_scope.explanation: The key does not carry every scope this endpoint needs. The response lists the scopes the call needs in required and the ones the key lacks in missing.
insufficient_scope.fix: Create a key with the missing scopes in Settings → API keys. Keys cannot be edited, so replace the old one.

product_not_licensed.title: Product not licensed
product_not_licensed.explanation: The endpoint belongs to a Synapse product the organisation does not subscribe to.
product_not_licensed.fix: Ask the venue to enable the product, or stop calling this endpoint for that organisation.

module_not_licensed.title: Module not licensed
module_not_licensed.explanation: The endpoint belongs to a module that is not enabled for the organisation.
module_not_licensed.fix: Ask the venue to enable the module, or stop calling this endpoint for that organisation.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.explanation: No record with that ID exists in the key's organisation. An ID with the wrong prefix, such as a reservation ID passed where a member ID is expected, is also not found.
not_found.fix: Check the ID and its prefix. IDs from another organisation are never visible.

route_not_found.title: Route not found
route_not_found.explanation: No endpoint exists at this method and path.
route_not_found.fix: Check the path against the reference. Every path starts with /public/v1/.

method_not_allowed.title: Method not allowed
method_not_allowed.explanation: The path exists but does not accept this HTTP method.
method_not_allowed.fix: Use the method shown for this path in the reference.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.explanation: The request conflicts with the current state of the record.
conflict.fix: Fetch the record again, then decide whether to retry.

idempotency_in_flight.title: Request in progress
idempotency_in_flight.explanation: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running.
idempotency_in_flight.fix: Wait a moment and retry with the same key. You will get the original response once it finishes.

payload_too_large.title: Payload too large
payload_too_large.explanation: The request body is larger than the API accepts.
payload_too_large.fix: Send a smaller body. Split bulk work into several requests.

unsupported_media_type.title: Unsupported media type
unsupported_media_type.explanation: The Content-Type header is not one this endpoint reads.

unprocessable.title: Unprocessable
unprocessable.explanation: The request was valid but could not be carried out.
unprocessable.fix: Read the detail field for the reason.

idempotency_key_reused.title: Idempotency-Key reused
idempotency_key_reused.explanation: This Idempotency-Key was already used in the last 24 hours with a different method, path or body.
idempotency_key_reused.fix: Use a new key for a new request. Reuse a key only to retry exactly the same request.

rate_limited.title: Rate limit exceeded
rate_limited.explanation: The key has used its request budget: a burst of 50, refilled at 1,000 an hour. The Retry-After header says how many seconds to wait.
rate_limited.fix: Wait for Retry-After seconds, then retry. Watch RateLimit-Remaining to slow down before you hit the limit.

too_many_failed_attempts.title: Too many failed attempts
too_many_failed_attempts.explanation: Too many requests from this address failed authentication: more than 30 in a minute. Requests are refused until the window passes, even with a valid key.
too_many_failed_attempts.fix: Fix the key your client sends, then wait for Retry-After seconds.

internal_error.title: Internal error
internal_error.explanation: Something went wrong on our side. The request may or may not have taken effect.
internal_error.fix: Retry with the same Idempotency-Key if the call takes one. If it keeps happening, contact support with the instance value.
